# axm commands

Manage slash-command extensions.

## When to use

Use this command family when adding reusable slash commands to configured coding agents.

## Usage

```bash
axm commands <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](global-flags).

## Examples

**Add a command from the registry**

```bash
axm commands install @acme/commands/my-cmd
```

**List installed commands**

```bash
axm commands list
```

**Enable a disabled command**

```bash
axm commands enable my-cmd
```

**Remove a command**

```bash
axm commands uninstall my-cmd
```

**Scaffold a new command**

```bash
axm commands new my-cmd
```

**Publish a command to a registry**

```bash
axm commands publish @acme/commands/my-cmd
```

**Bump a command version**

```bash
axm commands version @acme/commands/my-cmd patch
```

## Subcommands

| Command                                      | Summary                                                                                |
| -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [axm commands install](commands/install)     | Reinstall configured commands from their sources, or install a command from a registry |
| [axm commands uninstall](commands/uninstall) | Uninstall a command                                                                    |
| [axm commands list](commands/list)           | List installed commands                                                                |
| [axm commands enable](commands/enable)       | Enable a previously disabled command                                                   |
| [axm commands disable](commands/disable)     | Disable a command without uninstalling it                                              |
| [axm commands update](commands/update)       | Update installed commands to latest versions                                           |
| [axm commands new](commands/new)             | Create a new command                                                                   |
| [axm commands version](commands/version)     | Bump a managed command manifest version                                                |
| [axm commands publish](commands/publish)     | Publish command extensions to a registry                                               |

## Requirements

- workspace

## Side effects

None.
